requirements.text: The system will interface with the bar-code reader to interface all transaction details.
The system will interface with the thumb-print reader for verifying claims form used by the clients.
Voucher numbers are system generated and created with unique identification numbers.
The system shall provide a validity date check for the period of vouchers to be used in the program.
The system shall allow authorized users to amend or alter the validity date of vouchers.
The system shall provide a mechanism to with-hold any voucher number.
The system shall capture master details of every distributor including unique code, name, address, locations, and type of business.
The system shall generate an auto-generated number as Distribution Invoice No.
The system shall automatically calculate the invoice amount as the wholesale rate multiplied by the quantity sold.
The system shall automatically generate a Claim number with Hospital Code as Suffix plus 8 digits.
The system shall automatically change the status of a VSP to In-activate if more than two fraud entries are found during the claim process.
The system shall automatically generate Staff Code with Suffix as VSP Code plus SC plus 3 digits.
The system shall print a receipt document based on the information entered during claim submission.
The system shall automatically calculate the claim amount based on the VSP payment terms and drug retail prices.
The system shall check if a returned voucher was sold to the specific distributor during a sales return transaction.
The system shall save user information only if the Password and Verify password values are equal.
The system shall implement encryption for data at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+), and maintain an immutable audit log of all administrative and data-modifying actions.
The system shall enforce a password policy requiring a minimum of 12 characters, including uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters.
The system shall store biometric data as non-reversible cryptographic hashes and ensure compliance with local data protection laws regarding sensitive health and biometric information.

The system shall implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) where access to sensitive functions (e.g., amending voucher validity, deactivating VSPs) is restricted to specific, authenticated administrative roles.
The system shall automatically change the status of a VSP to 'In-active' if more than two claims are flagged as 'Fraud' by the system or manual audit within a rolling 30-day period.
The system shall implement role-based access control (RBAC) and maintain an immutable audit log of all create, update, and delete operations, compliant with industry-standard security practices.
The database shall be designed to support a minimum of 20,000 vouchers per pilot period with query response times for standard reports not exceeding 5 seconds under normal load.
The system shall perform database maintenance tasks, including index defragmentation, during scheduled off-peak hours to ensure no disruption to daily claim processing.
The system shall process and save a claim entry in under 2 seconds under a concurrent load of 50 users.
The system shall support a database growth of up to 1,000,000 vouchers and 500 concurrent users without degradation in query response times.
Biometric verification and security validation checks shall not add more than 500ms to the total transaction processing time.
